metaDescription: Order custom blue lanyards for your team or event. Perfect for ID badges, keys, and giveaways. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Blue lanyards are a popular choice for corporate events, trade shows, and employee ID badges because the color conveys trust and professionalism. Whether you choose a woven polyester style like the 3/4" Woven Lanyard for a soft feel or a durable nylon web option for heavy use, imprinting your logo in white or silver creates strong contrast. Custom blue lanyards help attendees and staff stand out while keeping credentials secure.
heroAltText: Custom blue lanyards with printed logos and metal clips for ID badges and keys
